text.en:
The articles specifically listed in the Annex (Articles Granted
Zero Duty in 2010 under the CEPT Scheme for the AFTA) hereof, as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be
subiect to the ASEAN CEPT rates in accordance with the schedule indicated in
Columns 4 and 5 of said Annex. The ASEAN CEPT rates so indicated shall be
accorded to imports coming from ASEAN Member States applying CEPT
concession to the same products pursuant to Article 4 of the CEPT Agreement
and its Interpretative Notes.

From the date of effectivity of this Executive Order, all
articles listed in the Annex which are entered or withdrawn from warehouses in
the Philippines for consumption shall be imposed the rates of duty therein
prescribed subiect to compliance with the Rules of Origin as provided in the
Agreement on the CEPT Scheme for the AFTA signed on 28 January 1992, as

The tariff rates listed in the Annex and all relevant Executive
•Orders issued in compliance with CEPT tariff reduction/elimination commitments
are in accordance with the obligations under Articles 19 (Reduction or Elimination
of Import Duties) and 21 (Issuance of Legal Enactments) of the ATIGA.

Nothing in this Executive Order shall preclude the Philippines
from invoking its right of recourse to all trade remedy measures provided for in
its law, this Agreement and relevant international agreements as an effective
device against import surges.

The provisions of this Executive Order are hereby declared
separable and in the event any such provision is declared invalid or
unconstitutional; the other provisions, which are not affected thereby, remain in
force and effect.

All presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect on 01 January 2010
following its complete publication in the Official Gazette or in a national
newspaper of general circulation.
